verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an in-app AI palette (cmd+j) with about a dozen prompts such as 'list key takeaways' and 'list action-items', plus free-form questions and saved custom prompts. It also lets you 'chat' with filtered sets of notes to ask questions and extract information, with answers linked to source notes, and you can choose GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insight quality, and evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestions, since all documented AI output is user-invoked.
